legal_trigger: Resort to armed force between states, including occupation
core_law: Four Geneva Conventions, Additional Protocol I where applicable, customary IHL
common_issues: Occupation, POW status, protected persons, inter-state hostilities.

legal_trigger: Protracted armed violence between state and organized armed group or between organized armed groups
core_law: Common Article 3, Additional Protocol II where applicable, customary IHL
common_issues: Organization of armed group, intensity threshold, detention, humanitarian access.

legal_trigger: Territory placed under authority of hostile army without sovereign consent
core_law: Hague Regulations, Geneva Convention IV, customary IHL
common_issues: Public order, resource use, settlements, detention, humanitarian relief, protected civilians.

legal_trigger: Multiple actors and legal relationships operating simultaneously
common_issues: Foreign intervention, proxy actors, internationalized NIACs, cross-border operations.
